    <style>
    /* ─── BRAND TOKENS (Manual de Marca 2024) ─────────────── */
    :root {
    /* Primary palette */
    --eerie-black: #1A1A1A;
    --outer-space: #464646;
    --silver: #B3B3B3;
    --white-smoke: #F2F2F2;
    /* Secondary palette */
    --navy: #000083;
    --medium-blue: #0000D0;
    --vivid-sky: #3CD2F0;
    /* ── Complementary palette (Manual p.23) ── */
    /* Use ONLY for highlights, key data, and accent text. Never logo, never bg. */
    --c-violet: #7C00FF; /* stats / numbers that shock */
    --c-orange: #FF6600; /* warnings / downtime / risk */
    --c-pink: #FF00B1; /* CTAs secondary / plan badges */
    --c-amber: #FF9900; /* sources / labels / trust items */
    /* Dimmed variants for backgrounds (5–10% opacity) */
    --c-violet-dim: rgba(124,0,255,0.10);
    --c-orange-dim: rgba(255,102,0,0.10);
    --c-pink-dim: rgba(255,0,177,0.10);
    --c-amber-dim: rgba(255,153,0,0.10);
    /* UI aliases */
    --bg: #111111;
    --bg-card: #1A1A1A;
    --bg-card-2: #202020;
    --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    --border-strong: rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
    --text-primary: #F2F2F2;
    --text-muted: #B3B3B3;
    --text-dim: #808080; /* bumped from #646464 → more readable */
    --accent: #3CD2F0;
    --accent-blue: #0000D0;
    --prompt: #3CD2F0; /* the _ character per brand manual */
    }
    *,*::before,*::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    padding-bottom: 72px;
    }
    /* Subtle T-mark grid bg — references the brand symbol */
    body::after {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(60,210,240,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(60,210,240,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 80px 80px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
    }
    /* ─── LAYOUT ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container { max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }
    section { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    /* ─── TYPOGRAPHY (JetBrains Mono for headings, Lato for body) */
    .mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
    /* Brand heading pattern: Title_ with blue underscore */
    .heading {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.08;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .heading .prompt { color: var(--prompt); font-weight: 800; }
    .label-tag {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: .15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    /* ── COMPLEMENTARY COLOR APPLICATIONS (Manual p.23) ─────────── */
    /* Violet (#7C00FF) — shocking stats, big numbers that create urgency */
    .stat-num { color: var(--c-violet) !important; }
    /* Orange (#FF6600) — downtime, risk, cost of inaction */
    .c-orange { color: var(--c-orange); }
    .anchor-callout p { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .anchor-callout p strong { color: var(--c-orange); }
    /* Amber (#FF9900) — data sources, trust labels, "verified" signals */
    .stat-src, .anchor-src { color: var(--c-amber) !important; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; }
    .hero-trust-item { color: var(--c-amber) !important; }
    /* Pink (#FF00B1) — Most Popular badge, key differentiators */
    .pop-badge { background: var(--c-pink) !important; border-color: var(--c-pink) !important; }
    .plan-card.popular .plan-name { color: var(--c-pink) !important; }
    /* Violet for large trust/about numbers */
    .trust-num { color: var(--vivid-sky); } /* keep blue — less shocking context */
    .about-stat-n { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .about-stat-n span { color: var(--c-violet); }
    /* Orange for downtime cost callout number */
    .downtime-cost { color: var(--c-orange); }
    /* Amber for "source" labels throughout stats section */
    .source-badge {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--c-amber);
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    /* Business outcomes arrows — green stays green, use complementary for urgency items */
    .outcome-down { color: #22C55E; } /* ↓ Downtime, ↓ Risk, ↓ Complexity */
    .outcome-up { color: var(--vivid-sky); } /* ↑ items */
    /* Readability: boost text-muted globally */
    .body { color: #C8C8C8; }
    .body-lg { color: #C0C0C0; }
    .body-lg { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300; color: #C0C0C0; line-height: 1.75; }
    .body { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 300; color: #C8C8C8; line-height: 1.7; }
    /* ─── BUTTONS ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn-primary {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    background: var(--medium-blue);
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;
    padding: 14px 28px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background .2s, transform .15s, box-shadow .2s;
    border: none; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
    background: #0000a8;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,208,0.35);
    }
    .btn-ghost {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px;
    padding: 13px 28px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    transition: border-color .2s, color .2s, background .2s;
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
    /* ─── LOGO SVG (inline, faithful to brand) ─────────────── */
    .logo-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; text-decoration: none; }
    .logo-svg { height: 28px; width: auto; }
    /* ─── NAV ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    padding: 18px 0;
    transition: background .3s, border-color .3s, padding .25s;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    nav.scrolled {
    background: rgba(17,17,17,0.95);
    border-color: var(--border);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    padding: 13px 0;
    }
    .nav-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; }
    .nav-unit { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .nav-unit-label {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    letter-spacing: .12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-left: 2px;
    }
    .nav-phone {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);
    text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: .04em;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    transition: color .2s;
    }
    .nav-phone:hover { color: var(--accent); }
    /* ─── HERO ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding: 140px 0 96px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-radial {
    position: absolute; top: -160px; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 1000px; height: 700px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(0,0,208,0.08) 0%, transparent 65%);
    pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 860px; }
    /* Brand badge */
    .hero-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    background: rgba(60,210,240,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(60,210,240,0.2);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    animation: blink 2s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.3} }
    .hero-badge-text {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .08em;
    }
    .hero-h1 {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: clamp(32px, 5.5vw, 68px);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.04;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .hero-h1 .hl { color: var(--vivid-sky); margin-left: .08em; }
    .hero-h1 .prompt { color: var(--prompt); }
    .hero-sub {
    font-size: clamp(15px, 1.8vw, 19px);
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    line-height: 1.7;
    max-width: 620px;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .hero-sub strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 400; }
    .hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 56px; }
    .hero-trust {
    display: flex; gap: 28px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .hero-trust-item {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim);
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    .trust-check {
    width: 14px; height: 14px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(60,210,240,0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(60,210,240,0.3);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    /* ─── DIVIDER ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .section-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    /* ─── ANCHOR COMPARISON ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .anchor { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--eerie-black); }
    .anchor-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 52px 0 36px;
    }
    .anchor-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    padding: 36px 32px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
    }
    .anchor-card.featured { background: #0a0a20; position: relative; }
    .anchor-card.featured::before {
    content: 'LESS THAN YOUR COFFEE_';
    position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    background: var(--medium-blue);
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .15em;
    padding: 5px 0;
    text-align: center;
    }
    .anchor-icon { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .anchor-label {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-dim); letter-spacing: .1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .anchor-amount {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    line-height: 1;
    }
    .anchor-amount.blue { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .anchor-per { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-dim); margin-left: 4px; }
    .anchor-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.55; }
    .anchor-src { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: auto; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .anchor-callout {
    background: rgba(239,68,68,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.15);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 28px 32px;
    }
    .anchor-callout p {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 19px);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .anchor-callout .src {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-dim);
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    /* ─── STATS ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .stats { padding: 88px 0; }
    .stats-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px; background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    margin: 52px 0 40px;
    }
    .stat-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    padding: 36px 28px;
    transition: background .2s;
    }
    .stat-card:hover { background: var(--bg-card-2); }
    .stat-num {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 52px);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    color: #EF4444;
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .stat-num .prompt { color: var(--prompt); }
    .stat-desc { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .stat-src { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim); letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .blockquote {
    border-left: 3px solid var(--c-violet);
    padding: 20px 28px;
    background: var(--c-violet-dim);
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    margin-top: 40px;
    }
    .blockquote.orange { border-left-color: var(--c-orange); background: var(--c-orange-dim); }
    .blockquote.amber { border-left-color: var(--c-amber); background: var(--c-amber-dim); }
    .blockquote.pink { border-left-color: var(--c-pink); background: var(--c-pink-dim); }
    .blockquote p {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: clamp(14px, 1.6vw, 17px);
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    line-height: 1.6;
    font-style: italic;
    }
    /* ─── BEFORE / AFTER ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .ba { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--eerie-black); }
    .ba-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1px; background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 52px;
    }
    .ba-col { padding: 40px 36px; }
    .ba-before { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.04); }
    .ba-after { background: rgba(60,210,240,0.04); }
    .ba-title {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    .ba-before .ba-title { color: #EF4444; }
    .ba-after .ba-title { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .ba-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .ba-list li {
    font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted);
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    padding-left: 0;
    }
    .ba-list li::before {
    content: '';
    width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%;
    flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .ba-before .ba-list li::before { background: #EF4444; }
    .ba-after .ba-list li::before { background: var(--vivid-sky); }
    /* ─── PLANS ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .plans { padding: 88px 0; }
    .plans-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(196px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px; background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    margin: 52px 0 28px;
    }
    .plan-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    padding: 28px 20px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px;
    transition: background .2s;
    position: relative;
    }
    .plan-card:hover { background: var(--bg-card-2); }
    .plan-card.popular { background: #090916; border-top: 2px solid var(--medium-blue); }
    .pop-badge {
    position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--medium-blue);
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 4px 14px;
    border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .plan-name {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    }
    .plan-card.popular .plan-name { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .plan-price {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight: 800; line-height: 1;
    }
    .plan-price .amt { font-size: 34px; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
    .plan-price .per { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 400; }
    .plan-price.custom .amt { font-size: 22px; }
    .plan-desc {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.55;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 14px;
    }
    .plan-feats { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; flex: 1; }
    .plan-feats li {
    font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim);
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .plan-feats li::before {
    content: '→';
    color: var(--vivid-sky);
    flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 1px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }
    .plan-best {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim);
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    }
    .plan-cta {
    display: block; text-align: center;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
    padding: 10px; border-radius: 3px;
    text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all .2s;
    }
    .plan-card.popular .plan-cta {
    background: var(--medium-blue); border-color: var(--medium-blue); color: #fff;
    }
    .plan-cta:hover { background: var(--medium-blue); border-color: var(--medium-blue); color: #fff; }
    /* ─── SOCIAL PROOF ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .proof { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--eerie-black); }
    .testimonials {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px; background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    margin: 52px 0 1px;
    }
    .testimonial {
    background: var(--bg-card-2);
    padding: 36px 28px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px;
    }
    .t-quote {
    font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted);
    line-height: 1.75; font-style: italic; flex: 1;
    }
    .t-quote::before {
    content: '"';
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 52px; font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--medium-blue);
    line-height: .7; display: block; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .t-author {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 18px;
    }
    .t-avatar {
    width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(0,0,208,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(60,210,240,0.25);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--vivid-sky); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .t-name {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .t-role { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .t-placeholder {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .06em;
    color: rgba(245,158,11,0.6); margin-top: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .trust-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 1px; background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .trust-item {
    background: #161616;
    padding: 22px 20px; text-align: center;
    }
    .trust-num {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--vivid-sky); letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .trust-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    /* ─── ABOUT ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .about { padding: 88px 0; }
    .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 72px; align-items: start; }
    .about-right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .about-stats {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1px; background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .about-stat { background: var(--bg-card); padding: 24px 20px; text-align: center; }
    .about-stat-n {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .about-stat-n span { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .about-stat-d { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .global-badge {
    background: rgba(0,0,208,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(60,210,240,0.18);
    border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px 24px; text-align: center;
    }
    .global-badge .n {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--vivid-sky); margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .global-badge .d { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .cities-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px 24px;
    }
    .cities-card .ctitle {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .cities-card .clist { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); line-height: 2; }
    /* ─── FINAL CTA ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .final-cta {
    padding: 120px 0;
    background: var(--eerie-black);
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .final-glow {
    position: absolute; bottom: -300px; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 900px; height: 700px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(0,0,208,0.1) 0%, transparent 60%);
    pointer-events: none;
    }
    .final-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 760px; }
    .final-h2 {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 52px);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .final-h2 .hl { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .final-h2 .prompt { color: var(--prompt); }
    .assessment-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px; margin: 40px 0;
    }
    .assess-item {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 16px;
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .assess-check {
    width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(60,210,240,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(60,210,240,0.25);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px;
    }
    .final-ctas { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 28px; }
    .final-note { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); letter-spacing: .02em; }
    .final-cities { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #3a3a3a; margin-top: 8px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    /* ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 36px 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    }
    .footer-inner {
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-brand {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .footer-copy { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 4px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin-top: 6px; }
    .footer-links a { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-dim); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color .2s; }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .footer-right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 5px; }
    .footer-contact a { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; }
    .footer-contact a:hover { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .footer-tagline { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: #2a2a2a; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    /* ─── SCROLL ANIMATIONS ──────────────────────────────────── */
    .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); transition: opacity .55s ease, transform .55s ease; }
    .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    /* ─── RESPONSIVE ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .ba-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    .footer-inner { flex-direction: column; }
    .footer-right { align-items: flex-start; }
    .nav-phone { display: none; }
    .hero-h1 { font-size: clamp(28px, 8vw, 48px); }
    /* Split image+text grids */
    [style*="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"] { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
    [style*="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"] > [style*="height:300px"],
    [style*="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"] > [style*="height:320px"] { height: 200px !important; order: -1; }
    }
    /* ── PLAN CAROUSEL (mobile) ──────────────────────────────────── */
    .plan-dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--border-strong); border: none; cursor: pointer;
    transition: background .2s, transform .2s; padding: 0;
    }
    .plan-dot.active { background: var(--vivid-sky); transform: scale(1.3); }
    /* Mobile card — only one visible at a time */
    @media (max-width: 860px) {
    #plan-nav { display: flex !important; }
    #plan-arrows { display: flex !important; }
    #plan-track {
    display: block !important;
    background: none !important;
    border: none !important;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 460px;
    }
    .plan-card {
    display: none !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
    border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(40px);
    transition: opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
    }
    .plan-card.card-active {
    display: flex !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: translateX(0) !important;
    }
    .plan-card.popular {
    border-top: 2px solid var(--c-pink) !important;
    }
    }
    /* ── CATEGORY FILTER BUTTONS ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .cat-btn {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    color: var(--text-dim); cursor: pointer;
    transition: all .18s;
    }
    .cat-btn:hover { border-color: var(--vivid-sky); color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .cat-btn.active { background: var(--medium-blue); border-color: var(--medium-blue); color: #fff; }
    /* ── COMPARISON TABLE ROWS ───────────────────────────────────── */
    .cmp-row { cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; }
    .cmp-row:hover { background: rgba(60,210,240,0.04) !important; }
    .cmp-row.cat-hidden { display: none; }
    .cmp-explain {
    display: none;
    padding: 0 16px 14px;
    animation: slideDown .25s ease;
    }
    .cmp-explain.open { display: table-row; }
    @keyframes slideDown { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(-6px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
    /* ── STICKY BOTTOM CTA BAR ───────────────────────────────────── */
    .sticky-cta {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 90;
    background: rgba(8,8,16,0.97);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(60,210,240,0.25);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    padding: 14px 28px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    transform: translateY(100%);
    transition: transform .35s ease;
    }
    .sticky-cta.visible { transform: translateY(0); }
    .sticky-cta-text {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .sticky-cta-text span { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    .sticky-cta-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
    .sticky-phone {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    transition: color .2s;
    }
    .sticky-phone:hover { color: var(--vivid-sky); }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .sticky-cta { padding: 12px 16px; }
    .sticky-cta-text { font-size: 12px; }
    }
    /* ── LANGUAGE SWITCHER ───────────────────────────────── */
    .lang-switcher{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:12px}
    .lang-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);color:var(--text-muted);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;line-height:1}
    .lang-btn:hover,.lang-btn.active{border-color:var(--vivid-sky);color:#fff;background:rgba(60,210,240,.12)}
    .lang-btn span{font-size:15px;margin-right:4px}
    @media(max-width:768px){.lang-switcher{gap:4px;margin-left:auto}.lang-btn{font-size:0;padding:7px}.lang-btn span{font-size:16px;margin-right:0}}
    /* ── SPACING SAFEGUARDS FOR MULTILINGUAL TEXT ─────────────── */
    .faq-num{display:inline-block;margin-right:10px;color:var(--c-violet);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0}
    .faq-question-text{display:inline;white-space:normal}
    .faq-item.faq-open .faq-toggle{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .faq-toggle span:first-child{min-width:0}
    .faq-panel{will-change:max-height}
    .hero-h1 .hl{display:inline-block}
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
